signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Define success metrics and build measurement frameworks for clinician activation, engagement, and retention — particularly in greenfield areas where metrics aren’t yet established
Conduct deep-dive funnel analyses to understand where clinicians drop off, what drives engagement, and what distinguishes power users from churned ones
Build and maintain dashboards and self-service analytics tools that give the broader team visibility into funnel performance and product health
Partner with Engineering to advocate for upstream instrumentation best practices — ensuring events are captured with consistent schemas and sufficient fidelity to answer growth…
